import hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
from workflow.contract_context import ContractContext
from workflow.contract_generation import ContractGenerator
from workflow.generation_constraints import bounded_response_model, financial_reference_contract
from workflow.schema_contract import schema_enum_contract
from workflow.llm_client import schema_cardinality_contract
from schemas.contract_outputs import ContractResearchAnalysis, CONTRACT_VERSION
from slm.granite_provider import render_granite_pair
root = Path.cwd()
original = Path('C:/Users/JasmineJiang/Projects/multiple-ai-agent_SLM_LLM')
report_path = root.parent / 'validation/prompt_efficiency.json'
if report_path.exists():
    raise FileExistsError('Refuse to overwrite an existing efficiency audit')
body_path = original / 'docs/final_sprint/s3-two-stage-v1/run_01/audit/01_research_generate.raw.txt'
usage_path = original / 'docs/final_sprint/s3-two-stage-v1/run_01/audit/01_research_generate.usage.json'
tokenizer_path = original / 'docs/final_sprint/s3-v1/setup/tokenizer.json'
input_paths = [body_path, usage_path, tokenizer_path,
    *[root / 'docs/final_sprint/s0-v1/cases/ai_education' / name for name in ('brief.json','packet.json','case.json')]]
source_names = ('workflow/contract_generation.py', 'workflow/two_stage_generation.py',
                'workflow/contract_context.py', 'workflow/finance_contract.py',
                'workflow/generation_constraints.py', 'workflow/schema_contract.py',
                'workflow/llm_client.py', 'schemas/contract_outputs.py', 'slm/granite_provider.py')
source_paths = [base / name for base in (original, root) for name in source_names]
def digest(path): return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
fingerprints = {str(path): digest(path) for path in input_paths + source_paths}
body = json.loads(body_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
usage = json.loads(usage_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert usage['eval_count'] == 941 and usage['done_reason'] == 'stop'
ctx = ContractContext.from_case(root/'docs/final_sprint/s0-v1', 'ai_education', condition='D')
tokenizer = Tokenizer.from_file(str(tokenizer_path))
def module(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = mod
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod
old_stage = module('efficiency_old_stage', original/'workflow/two_stage_generation.py')
old_generator = module('efficiency_old_generator', original/'workflow/contract_generation.py')
assert old_generator.PROMPT_VERSION == 'grounded-generation-v5-two-stage'
old_plan = old_stage.SelectionPlan(ContractResearchAnalysis, body, ctx)
old_schema = bounded_response_model(old_plan.schema, ctx.finance.value_ids, packet=ctx.packet)
old_base = (f'{old_generator.PROMPT_VERSION}\n{old_generator.ROLE_INSTRUCTION["research"]}\nartifact_version=1.\n' +
            json.dumps(ctx.input_payload('research'), ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':')))
def contracts(schema):
    return ('\n\n' + schema_enum_contract(schema) + '\n\n' + schema_cardinality_contract(schema) +
            '\n\n' + financial_reference_contract(ctx.finance.value_ids))
old_grounding_prompt = old_base + '\n\n' + old_plan.prompt() + contracts(old_schema)
old_body_schema = bounded_response_model(old_stage.draft_model(ContractResearchAnalysis), ctx.finance.value_ids, packet=ctx.packet)
old_body_prompt = old_base + '\n\n' + old_stage.BODY_INSTRUCTION + contracts(old_body_schema)
class Captured(Exception): pass
class CaptureClient:
    def __init__(self): self.calls = []
    def generate_structured_once(self, prompt, schema, **kwargs):
        self.calls.append((prompt, schema, kwargs))
        if schema.__generation_stage__ == 'body': return schema.model_validate(body)
        raise Captured('Offline boundary: provider is never called')
client = CaptureClient()
try: ContractGenerator(client).generate(ctx, 'research')
except Captured: pass
assert len(client.calls) == 2
new_grounding_prompt, new_schema, new_options = client.calls[1]
new_plan = new_schema.__selection_plan__
def metric(text):
    return {'characters': len(text), 'utf8_bytes': len(text.encode('utf-8')),
            'tokenizer_tokens': len(tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False).ids)}
def render(system, prompt):
    return render_granite_pair([{'role':'system','content':system},{'role':'user','content':prompt}])
def schema_text(schema): return json.dumps(schema.model_json_schema(), ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':'))
old_render = render(old_generator.COMMON_INSTRUCTION, old_grounding_prompt)
new_render = render(new_options['system_instruction'], new_grounding_prompt)
old_body_render = render(old_generator.COMMON_INSTRUCTION+'\n'+old_stage.BODY_INSTRUCTION, old_body_prompt)
new_body_render = render(client.calls[0][2]['system_instruction'], client.calls[0][0])
old_prefix = os.path.commonprefix([old_body_render, old_render])
new_prefix = os.path.commonprefix([new_body_render, new_render])
checks = dict(complete_frozen_body_equal=old_plan.body == new_plan.body,
              complete_audit_catalog_equal=old_plan.catalog() == new_plan.catalog(),
              groups_equal=old_plan.groups == new_plan.groups,
              body_candidates_equal=old_plan.body_spans == new_plan.body_spans,
              evidence_candidates_equal=old_plan.evidence_spans == new_plan.evidence_spans,
              new_phase_system_identical=client.calls[0][2]['system_instruction'] == new_options['system_instruction'])
assert all(checks.values())
changed_during_audit = [path for path, expected in fingerprints.items() if digest(Path(path)) != expected]
assert not changed_during_audit, changed_during_audit
result = dict(
    created_at_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    audit_kind='offline_reconstruction_of_saved_real_research_body', real_model_calls=0,
    execution={'working_directory':str(root), 'executable':sys.executable,
        'argv':['-B','-c','import sys; source=sys.stdin.read(); exec(compile(source, "<efficiency_audit>", "exec"))'],
        'stdin_script':source, 'stdin_script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()},
    file_sha256=fingerprints,
    input_identity={'case_id':ctx.case_id,'brief_sha256':ctx.brief_sha256,'packet_sha256':ctx.packet_sha256,
        'canonical_contract_version':CONTRACT_VERSION,'body_sha256':new_plan.body_sha256,
        'historical_actual_output_tokens':usage['eval_count'],'historical_duration_seconds':usage['total_duration']/1e9,
        'historical_prefill_tokens_per_second':usage['prefill_tokens_per_second'],
        'historical_generation_tokens_per_second':usage['generation_tokens_per_second']},
    metrics_basis={'input':'Official saved tokenizer on the complete rendered Granite system/user chat template, including role delimiters and generation prefix; reconstructed counts, not a new provider usage measurement.',
        'native_schema':'Compact JSON serialized schema sent as Ollama format; tokenizer token count is a schema size comparison only and is NOT added to prompt input or reported as actual inference usage.',
        'prefix':'Longest character prefix of stage-one and stage-two rendered text; tokenizer length describes cache-reuse opportunity only. No cache hit, throughput gain, or ninety-minute completion is asserted.',
        'invariants':'No frozen brief, packet, body, candidate, canonical field, or validation obligation removed. Existing body was reused only for offline comparison; this is not a completed Research/model run.'},
    before={'prompt_version':old_generator.PROMPT_VERSION,'grounding_chat_input':metric(old_render),
        'body_chat_input':metric(old_body_render),'selection_prompt':metric(old_plan.prompt()),
        'native_schema':metric(schema_text(old_schema)), 'shared_stage_prefix':metric(old_prefix)},
    after={'prompt_version':__import__('workflow.contract_generation',fromlist=['PROMPT_VERSION']).PROMPT_VERSION,
        'grounding_chat_input':metric(new_render),'body_chat_input':metric(new_body_render),
        'selection_prompt':metric(new_plan.prompt()),'native_schema':metric(schema_text(new_schema)),
        'shared_stage_prefix':metric(new_prefix)},
    candidates={'annotation_groups':len(new_plan.groups),'body_spans':len(new_plan.body_spans),
                'evidence_spans':len(new_plan.evidence_spans),'inherited_claim_lookup_count':len(new_plan.inherited_claim_evidence)},
    checks=checks,
    validation={'targeted_final_command':['-B','-m','pytest','tests/test_generation_efficiency.py','tests/test_two_stage_generation.py','-q','-p','no:cacheprovider'],
        'targeted_final_result':'35 passed in 4.78s',
        'prior_iteration_result':'1 failed, 34 passed in 4.93s; fixture reused one claim ID in multiple parents, and mutation changed one occurrence only. Test was corrected to mutate all same-ID occurrences before asserting the unchanged lineage gate; production validation was not changed.'})
result['savings']={'grounding_input_tokens':result['before']['grounding_chat_input']['tokenizer_tokens']-result['after']['grounding_chat_input']['tokenizer_tokens'],
    'native_schema_characters':result['before']['native_schema']['characters']-result['after']['native_schema']['characters']}
report_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with report_path.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as output:
    json.dump(result, output, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
print(json.dumps({'report':str(report_path),'before':result['before'],'after':result['after'],'checks':checks,'sha256':digest(report_path)},indent=2))
